notes.title: Tactical Breach Wizards, and it's just like Floating Point
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1043810/Tactical_Breach_Wizards/

Look, I'll level with you: for every other game we've made, I'm laying out what our new game Tactical Breach Wizards has in common with it. But Floating Point is a weird little game, and this is frankly gonna be a stretch. But here goes:

[list]
[*]It does feature some floating: when you knock someone through a window in Tactical Breach Wizards, you also cast slowfall on them to ensure a non-lethal takedown. That's floating! 

[*]As you unravel the plot, you get to lay it all out on a conspiracy board by connecting the major players with string. Red string! All right, we're cooking now!

[*]On the first level, there's some water. You can't go in it though. Help, we've stopped cooking.
[/list]
All right, that's as far as I can take this charade. Maybe just watch the trailer and see if it's the kind of thing you might like:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1043810/Tactical_Breach_Wizards/
